from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    marker=min((v for v in cnt if v!=0), key=lambda v:cnt[v])
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==marker]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)
    shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts}
    sh=max(r for r,c in shape)+1; sw=max(c for r,c in shape)+1
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-sh+1):
        for c in range(w-sw+1):
            if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc]==0 for dr,dc in shape):
                for dr,dc in shape: out[r+dr][c+dc]=marker
    return out

source='''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(cell for row in grid for cell in row)
    marker = min((color for color in counts if color != 0), key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == marker]
    top = min(r for r, _ in points)
    left = min(c for _, c in points)
    shape = {(r - top, c - left) for r, c in points}
    shape_height = max(r for r, _ in shape) + 1
    shape_width = max(c for _, c in shape) + 1

    result = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(height - shape_height + 1):
        for c in range(width - shape_width + 1):
            if all(grid[r + dr][c + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    result[r + dr][c + dc] = marker
    return result
